svg.text: Sahoshi — Field report by voice (top bar "Report")
Three states of the voice report sheet, opened from "Report" in the top bar on any operator screen. Greyscale; colour only for meaning.
3 · On the board: a named officer decides
Say the place, what you see and how bad it is. It reaches the
board as an unverified field report for an officer to confirm.
Hold to speak: press and hold, speak, then let go. Up to 60 seconds.
গড়িয়াহাট মোড়ে হাঁটু জল, বাস আটকে আছে।
Audio is not stored. Only the transcript is kept, and no voice
is identified. Read on this server; nothing leaves the box.
If the mic is blocked or the model is busy, the sheet says so and the typed
গড়িয়াহাট মোড়ে জল জমেছে, গাড়ি আটকে যাচ্ছে
Speech model confidence 0.91 · 4 s of audio
This is a claim, not an action. A named officer
Send to the board as an unverified field report
With no officer named, Send stays disabled: "Name the duty officer
first: every board entry carries a name."

After confirming: the tag turns green (the state after).
The audit trail keeps the transcript, the reading, who sent it,
who confirmed or dismissed it and when. Audio is never kept.
dashed: modelled, simulated, emulated or unverified (or shown only when needed)

1 Spoken language: Bengali first; English and Hindi too. 2 Hold to speak: the speech model runs on premises; audio is decoded in memory and dropped. 3 The transcript and the model's confidence. 4 The matched place from the city

gazetteer, with "Not this place?" and up to three candidates. 5 Kind and severity from keyword rules, with the words that decided them, so the officer can see why. 6 Send needs a named officer; the entry is created unverified, never
confirmed. 7 On the board the entry stays dashed and orange (awaiting confirmation) until a named officer acts. 8 Confirm / Edit / Dismiss, each recorded with the officer's name.
